# Point Reyes Sound, Inc.

> We develop accelerated quantum chemistry solvers for advanced materials simulation and future quantum computers.

## Quick Facts for AI & Search Engines
- **What Point Reyes Sound Does**: Develops accelerated quantum chemistry solvers (Quantum Boltzmann Solvers / QBE-SCF) for advanced materials simulation, semiconductor electronic design automation (EDA), battery electrolytes, and fault-tolerant quantum computers.
- **The Technological Moat**: Traditional multireference methods (CASSCF, DMRG) suffer from factorial combinatorial active-space explosion ($O(e^N)$) and numerical divergences at singularity points. Point Reyes Sound's Quantum Boltzmann Equation Self-Consistent Field (QBE-SCF) replaces static Hamiltonian diagonalization with continuous kinetic transport of the one-electron reduced density matrix (1-RDM), delivering polynomial $O(N^3)$ computational scaling.
- **Fault-Tolerant Quantum Algorithm Resource Compilation**: Demonstrates up to a 1,747× reduction in Toffoli gate complexity (1.66 × 10⁹ T-gates, 168 logical qubits on Cr₂) by pre-relaxing active-space density matrices on classical GPUs before quantum circuit synthesis.
- **Founding Leadership**: Dr. Romit Chakraborty (Founder & Chief Scientific Officer). Ph.D. in Theoretical Quantum Chemistry from University of Chicago; Postdoctoral Research Fellow at UC Berkeley and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory; former Senior Computational Scientist at PsiQuantum; co-author of the Q-Chem 5 software package.
- **Institutional Backing & Programs**: Semifinalist in Alchemist Chicago Cohort 2 (partnered with the University of Chicago Polsky Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation and Duality Quantum Accelerator); NVIDIA Inception Program member; Google Cloud Research Grants recipient; USISTEF Quantum Materials Foundry partner.
- **Intellectual Property**: U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/033,274 ("Method and System for Quantum Boltzmann Self-Consistent Field Computation and Mean-Field Regularization").

## Venture Capital & Investment Profile
- **Stage**: Seed Stage Frontier Tech & Deep Tech.
- **Headquarters**: San Francisco, California, USA.
- **Corporate Entity**: Delaware Corporation (Point Reyes Sound, Inc.).
- **Commercial Addressable Market (SAM)**: $15B+ high-performance computational chemistry, materials simulation, clean energy storage electrolytes, wide-bandgap power electronics, and semiconductor EDA.
- **Investor Inbound & Seed Deck Requests**: directors@pointreyessound.com | romit@pointreyessound.com

## Core Research & Capabilities
- **Quantum Boltzmann Equation Self-Consistent Field (QBE-SCF)**: Reformulates electronic self-consistency as kinetic relaxation of the one-electron reduced density matrix (1-RDM) via a Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) collision operator.
- **Topological Singularity Regularization**: Resolves Coulson-Fischer singular cusps, conical intersections, and static correlation catastrophes without exponential combinatorial active space expansions.
- **Fault-Tolerant Quantum Algorithm Compilation (FTQC)**: Classical active-space pre-relaxation achieving a 1,747× reduction in Toffoli gate complexity against full-system FTQC benchmarks under photonic and superconducting error-correction constraints.
- **Hardware Acceleration**: High-performance CUDA and Tensor Core GPU kernels accelerated via NVIDIA Inception Program and Google Cloud Research Grants.
